question: 平均缺陷率是多少

question: 整体平均良率是多少
reference_sql: SELECT AVG(first_pass_yield) AS avg_first_pass_yield FROM fact_production_record

question: 平均质量得分是多少

question: 总停机时长是多少分钟
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(downtime_minutes) AS total_downtime_minutes FROM fact_production_record

question: 一共发生了多少次故障
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(fault_event_count) AS total_faults FROM fact_production_record

question: 总产量是多少

question: 平均设备利用率是多少

question: 平均生产节拍是多少秒

question: 各生产线的平均缺陷率，从高到低排列
reference_sql: SELECT production_line, AVG(defect_rate) AS avg_defect_rate FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY production_line ORDER BY avg_defect_rate DESC

question: 每种产品的良率平均值分别是多少

question: 各班组的平均质量得分

reference_sql: SELECT production_line, SUM(production_volume) AS total_production_volume FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY production_line ORDER BY total_production_volume DESC

question: 各生产线的停机总时长

question: 各生产线的设备利用率平均水平
reference_sql: SELECT production_line, AVG(machine_utilization) AS avg_machine_utilization FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY production_line ORDER BY avg_machine_utilization DESC

question: 不同生产模式下的平均缺陷率

question: 每条生产线涉及多少台设备
reference_sql: SELECT production_line, COUNT(DISTINCT machine_id) AS machine_count FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY production_line ORDER BY machine_count DESC

question: 产量最高的十个批次
reference_sql: SELECT batch_id, SUM(production_volume) AS total_production_volume FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY batch_id ORDER BY total_production_volume DESC LIMIT 10

question: 缺陷率超过 5 的记录有多少条
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fact_production_record WHERE defect_rate > 5

question: 良率不足 90 的生产记录有几条

question: 停机超过半小时的记录数量
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM fact_production_record WHERE downtime_minutes > 30

question: 利用率不到 60 的设备编号有哪些
reference_sql: SELECT DISTINCT machine_id FROM fact_production_record WHERE machine_utilization < 60 ORDER BY machine_id

question: 出现过故障的记录占比是多少
reference_sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN fault_event_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS fault_ratio FROM fact_production_record

question: 质量得分高于 95 的记录数

question: 停机时间最长的 10 台设备

question: 良率最高的 5 条生产记录

question: 故障次数最多的 10 台设备
reference_sql: SELECT machine_id, SUM(fault_event_count) AS total_faults FROM fact_production_record GROUP BY machine_id ORDER BY total_faults DESC LIMIT 10

question: Night 班次的质量得分平均是多少

question: 缺陷率的最大值和最小值分别是多少

question: 综合效益得分的平均值
